generated.description: A large sci-fi invasion build: a dark, black-wool hull with lime and green accents, iron block plating, glowstone lights and iron bars, rising in a jagged, spread-out cluster. It is 172 wide, 88 high and 109 deep, with about 42,600 blocks, and includes chests, furnaces, a record player and signs inside. The source has no description, so the alien theme comes from the title and the palette.
